blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There is no direct evidence linking former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s influence to former lawmaker Zaldy Co in alleged budget insertions and kickback schemes in government infrastructure projects, Atty. Joshua Tan, Assistant Special Prosecutor of the Office of the Ombudsman said on Monday. Tan made the declaration during the bail hearing of Romualdez and his co-accused on the P7.4-billion plunder case before the Sandiganbayan Third Division, where prosecutors must show strong evidence of guilt to keep the respondents detained.
